rules: one lineage disposition row per canonical source_id
same underlying work or edition family must not be counted as independent corroboration
complementary volumes or page segments use WORK_PART and remain K2-eligible so unique coverage is not dropped
SAME_WORK_VARIANT must point directly to a PRIMARY_WORK or WORK_PART through variant_of_source_id
secondary notes and implementation evidence never count as independent traditional textual sources
semantic OUT_OF_SCOPE is distinct from source role: out-of-scope code remains IMPLEMENTATION and SKIP
OUT_OF_SCOPE and UNKNOWN semantic sources may remain non-eligible without blocking K2 lineage completion
lineage uncertainty must remain UNKNOWN rather than being guessed
